evals.prompt: Audit ConcurrencyViolations.swift for Core Data and SwiftData concurrency violations, thread confinement breaks, and unisolated model operations.
evals.expected_output: Audit report identifying unconfined context access on background queues, detached task context leaks, viewContext accessed outside MainActor, unisolated ModelContext, and mainContext access in background Tasks.
expectations: Identifies CD_THREAD_UNCONFINED_ACCESS for context operations on background queue without perform
Identifies CD_TASK_DETACHED_CONTEXT_LEAK for unconfined context operations across Task.detached
Identifies CD_VIEWCONTEXT_BACKGROUND_ACCESS for viewContext access in async method without @MainActor
Identifies SWIFTDATA_UNISOLATED_MODEL_CONTEXT for ModelContext initialization without @ModelActor
Identifies SWIFTDATA_MAINCONTEXT_IN_TASK for container.mainContext access inside detached task
Recommends context.perform, passing PersistentIdentifier/NSManagedObjectID, and @ModelActor workers

evals.prompt: Audit FaultThrashingNPlusOne.swift for Core Data fault thrashing, missing fetch batch sizes, and reactive SwiftUI query churn.
evals.expected_output: Audit report flagging NSFetchRequest executed without fetchBatchSize, nested relationship loop traversal causing N+1 query trips, and un-debounced searchable queries.
expectations: Identifies CD_FETCH_MISSING_BATCH_SIZE for NSFetchRequest lacking fetchBatchSize
Identifies CD_FAULT_THRASHING_N_PLUS_ONE for nested relationship traversal in loop
Identifies REACTIVE_QUERY_SEARCH_THRASH for .searchable bound directly to dynamic @Query without debounce
Recommends setting fetchBatchSize = 20, relationshipKeyPathsForPrefetching, and debounced search state

evals.prompt: Audit BatchingAndMemoryBloat.swift for row-by-row batch loops, memory bloat, and missing multi-context auto-merging.
evals.expected_output: Audit report identifying row-by-row deletions in loop, bulk insertion loops without context.reset(), and newBackgroundContext() lacking automaticallyMergesChangesFromParent.
expectations: Identifies CD_LOOP_ROW_BY_ROW_DELETE for loop calling context.delete() on individual objects
Identifies CD_UNBOUNDED_BATCH_IMPORT for loop saves without context.reset() or @autoreleasepool
Identifies CD_MISSING_AUTO_MERGE for newBackgroundContext() without automaticallyMergesChangesFromParent
Recommends NSBatchDeleteRequest/SwiftData batch delete, chunked reset loops, and auto-merge configuration

evals.prompt: Audit CloudKitAndMultiContextViolations.swift for CloudKit relationship inverse omissions, unique constraint traps, inline binary bloat, and synchronous store loads.
evals.expected_output: Audit report identifying CloudKit relationship missing inverse, @Attribute(.unique) conflict, inline binary data without external storage, preview disk container leaks, and synchronous store loading.
expectations: Identifies CLOUDKIT_MISSING_RELATIONSHIP_INVERSE for @Relationship lacking explicit inverse
Identifies CLOUDKIT_UNSUPPORTED_UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT for @Attribute(.unique) on CloudKit-synced model
Identifies PERSISTENCE_LARGE_BINARY_INLINE for Data property without @Attribute(.externalStorage)
Identifies SWIFTDATA_UNMARKED_TRANSIENT_PROPERTY for UI state property in @Model without @Transient
Identifies PERSISTENCE_PREVIEW_DISK_LEAK for #Preview initializing disk ModelContainer
Identifies CD_SYNCHRONOUS_STORE_LOAD for synchronous loadPersistentStores on main thread
